title: poa nepalensis var. nipponica
intro: Poa nepalensis var. nipponica, commonly known as Japanese blue grass, is a type of grass native to East Asia, often used in traditional medicine. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa nepalensis var. nipponica include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
